```{r msi_biomarker_header}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(is.null(pcg_report$content$msi$callset))
#| output: asis

cs <- pcgrr::color_palette$bm_callout
msi_content_bm <- pcg_report$content$msi

## basis for the MSI-High classification: result of external MSI caller, or
## prediction of the PCGR MSI classifier
msi_basis_text <- ""
if (isTRUE(msi_content_bm$external$eval)) {
  msi_basis_text <- paste0(
    " by the external MSI caller (",
    pcgrr::msi_external_display(msi_content_bm)$caller, ")")
} else {
  msi_stats_bm <- msi_content_bm$prediction$msi_stats
  if (!is.null(msi_stats_bm$prob_msi_h) && !is.na(msi_stats_bm$prob_msi_h)) {
    msi_basis_text <- paste0(
      " (P(MSI-H) = ", round(msi_stats_bm$prob_msi_h, 3),
      if (!is.null(msi_stats_bm$confidence_tier)) paste0(", confidence tier: ", msi_stats_bm$confidence_tier) else "", ")")
  }
}
cat("<br>\n\n### Biomarker evidence for MSI-High\n\n")
cat("The tumor was classified as MSI-High", msi_basis_text,
    ". Therapeutic implications of MSI-High were retrieved from ", bm_db_label,
    ", and are classified according to the strength of evidence for the tumor type (",
    pcg_report$settings$conf$sample_properties$site, "), following AMP/ASCO/CAP guidelines. ",
    if (nzchar(bm_db_tier_note)) paste0(bm_db_tier_note, " ") else "",
    "Expand a row for details on the underlying evidence items.\n\n", sep = "")
```

```{r msi_biomarker_sensitivity}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(is.null(pcg_report$content$msi$callset)) && any(pcg_report$content$msi$callset$variant_display$ACTIONABILITY_TIER %in% c(1,2,3))

rctbl_recs <- pcgrr::prep_actble_display_tbl(
  rep = pcg_report,
  tier = c(1,2,3),
  etype_for_tiering = c("predictive"),
  clnsig = "therapeutic_sensitivity",
  variant_category = 'msi')

result_table <-
  pcgrr::render_actble_bm_table(
    rctbl_recs = rctbl_recs,
    variant_category = 'msi',
    clnsig = "therapeutic_sensitivity"
  )

result_table
```

```{r msi_biomarker_sensitivity_none}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(is.null(pcg_report$content$msi$callset)) && !any(pcg_report$content$msi$callset$variant_display$ACTIONABILITY_TIER %in% c(1,2,3))

cs <- pcgrr::color_palette$bm_callout
cat(paste0("<div style='padding:8px 14px; border-left:4px solid ", cs$therapeutic_sensitivity$border, "; background:", cs$therapeutic_sensitivity$bg, "; border-radius:0 4px 4px 0; color:", cs$therapeutic_sensitivity$text, "; font-size:0.92em;'>Based on available data in ", bm_db_tier_label, ", no therapeutic sensitivity biomarkers (Tier 1&ndash;3) were identified for MSI-High in this tumor sample.</div>"))
```

```{r msi_biomarker_resistance}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(is.null(pcg_report$content$msi$callset)) && NROW(pcg_report$content$msi$callset$bm_evidence$therapeutic_resistance$classification) > 0

rctbl_recs <- pcgrr::prep_actble_display_tbl(
  rep = pcg_report,
  tier = c(1,2,3),
  clnsig = "therapeutic_resistance",
  variant_category = 'msi')

result_table <-
  pcgrr::render_actble_bm_table(
    rctbl_recs = rctbl_recs,
    variant_category = 'msi',
    clnsig = "therapeutic_resistance"
  )

if (!is.null(result_table)) {
  result_table
}
```
